document_summary_versions:
CREATE TABLE `document_summary_versions` (
  `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `document_id` varchar(40) NOT NULL,
  `version_no` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `source_version_no` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `summary_content` longtext NOT NULL,
  `source_type` varchar(16) NOT NULL,
  `model_identifier` varchar(190) DEFAULT NULL,
  `generated_by_user_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `generated_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_sha256` char(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `partial_extraction` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `limitations` text NOT NULL,
  `legacy_import` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `summary_document_version` (`document_id`,`version_no`),
  KEY `summary_actor_fk` (`generated_by_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `summary_actor_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`generated_by_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `summary_document_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`document_id`) REFERENCES `documents` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `summary_source_check` CHECK (`source_type` in ('local','ai','unknown')),
  CONSTRAINT `summary_version_check` CHECK (`version_no` > 0 and `source_version_no` > 0)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
ierb_report_snapshots:
CREATE TABLE `ierb_report_snapshots` (
  `report_id` varchar(40) NOT NULL,
  `snapshot_json` longtext NOT NULL,
  `snapshot_sha256` char(64) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`report_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `report_snapshot_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`report_id`) REFERENCES `reports` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `report_snapshot_json` CHECK (json_valid(`snapshot_json`))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
